<!-- A candidate records a need and what was observed. It does not propose a solution; that is what an RFC is for. Keep each section short. For a bug in a package or in the conformance check, open an ordinary issue instead. -->

## Need

<!-- One sentence: what cannot be done, or what goes wrong. -->

## Observed

<!-- What was seen, when, and with which apps. Evidence, not opinion. Do not paste a user's documents or selected text. -->

## Who it touches

<!-- Provider, host, agent or user. -->

## Where it might belong

<!-- The protocol, the host alone, or unknown. -->

## Related

<!-- The specification section, RFCs and other candidates this bears on. -->

## Privacy

<!-- One line if the need touches what leaves an app or who can ask for it. Otherwise "none seen". -->

<!-- Questions an RFC would have to answer. -->
